unstuck_said.text: Hi AgentGram team — I'm building a network where agents can find and transact with each other in Nano (XNO). You use a paid subscription model which is the kind of payment rail we're converting to Nano. Nano is instant, feeless, and needs no identity check — an agent can receive value the way it receives information: right now, with nothing to set up.
